messages:
maria: quick sync on form validation for billing page — leaning inline helpers on focus and errors on blur, card number validate live (Luhn). For deleting saved cards: typed confirm using last4. thoughts?

jamal: agree on Luhn live. For long address forms, surface a top summary on submit or a sticky error count if >5 fields.

sasha: a11y: errors must be programmatically linked (aria-describedby) and announced (aria-live=assertive). asterisk + visible '(required)' and aria-required=true. ensure contrast.

kevin: typed-last4 is fine for payment methods; avoid for minor deletes. CTA copy: use descriptive labels like 'Remove payment method'.

maria: great. acceptance criteria: inline errors on blur (card live), form-summary if fields>5, required marker + aria, typed-last4 for payment deletes, dialog meets keyboard/sr checks. I'll update figma and add to sprint.

jamal: i'll prototype sticky error count and PR ARIA attrs.

sasha: small reminder: don't rely on pseudo-elements for '*' — include real text for screen readers.

kevin: also log confirm_type event (boolean only, mask digits).
